name: Kor Trinivii; (The Bootana Hutta region, with Kor Trinivii represented by the number 19)
description: Kor Trinivii was a world located within the Kor Trinivii system, a part of the Bootana Hutta region of Hutt Space. It was situated in a part of the Slice section of the galaxy. It was connected by a hyperlane to the Kor Gejalli system.
lead_paragraphs: Kor Trinivii was a world located within the Kor Trinivii system, a part of the Bootana Hutta region of Hutt Space. It was situated in a part of the Slice section of the galaxy. It was connected by a hyperlane to the Kor Gejalli system.
Kor Trinivii was the throneworld of the Trinivii kajidic.
